description: This is a Python source file implementing a custom guardrail class 'EnkryptAIGuardrails' for integrating EnkryptAI's guardrails into the Litellm library. The class manages API calls to EnkryptAI, processes responses to detect violations such as toxicity, PII, and policy breaches, and provides hooks for pre- and post-LLM call integration, along with streaming support.

classes.name: EnkryptAIGuardrails
classes.description: A custom guardrail class integrating EnkryptAI's guardrails into Litellm, managing API requests, response processing, and various guardrail hooks for pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming.

methods.name: EnkryptAIProcessedResult _process_enkryptai_guardrails_response( self, response: EnkryptAIResponse )
methods.description: Processes the API response to identify detected attacks such as toxicity, policy violations, or PII leaks.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status( self, response_json: EnkryptAIResponse )
methods.description: Determines the overall status of guardrail compliance based on API response, classifying it as success, intervention, or failure.

methods.name: str _create_error_message(self, processed_result: EnkryptAIProcessedResult)
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message listing all detected violations from processed results.

methods.description: Pre-processing hook executed before LLM call, analyzing input messages for violations and potentially raising errors.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Runs during the LLM call for real-time moderation, analyzing input messages for violations.

methods.description: Post-processing hook examining responses for violations and raising errors if necessary.

methods.description: Applies the guardrail to a batch of texts, raising errors if any violations are found.
